petergyang.en:
I asked @jxnlco (DevEx at OpenAI): “What’s the craziest thing Codex did for you?”

Here’s his answer:

“I was on a bike ride when a coworker asked me to fix a launch video. So I connected remotely from my phone and asked Codex to use computer use to edit the video, export it, and post it back to Slack.

Twenty minutes later, there was a new video in the Slack thread. Then I told Codex:

‘Every 30 minutes, check the thread for feedback and export V2, V3, V4.’

By the time I got home, the launch video was greenlit.”

Codex had handled the revisions by repeatedly checking Slack for feedback.

📌 Watch the full episode here:
petergyang.zh:
我问@jxnlco（OpenAI 的 DevEx）：“Codex 为你做过的最疯狂的事情是什么？”

这是他的回答：

“当时我正在骑自行车，一位同事要求我修复发布视频。所以我通过手机远程连接，并要求 Codex 使用计算机来编辑视频、导出视频并将其发布回 Slack。

二十分钟后，Slack 线程中出现了一个新视频。然后我告诉法典：

“每 30 分钟检查一次线程的反馈并导出 V2、V3、V4。”

当我回到家时，发布视频已获批准。”

Codex 通过反复检查 Slack 的反馈来处理修订。

realmadhuguru.en:
Most product review meetings are annoying because they’re poorly run.

The best product reviews compress months of learnings into an hour by simulating the market reaction to your ideas. 

That only works if the people in the room deeply understand the space, have great product sense, strong opinions, and are often right.

Too many product reviews have drifted toward status updates, leadership visibility, and cross-functional alignment.

When that happens, people naturally resent them because it feels more like overhead and less like learning.
realmadhuguru.zh:
大多数产品评审会议都很烦人，因为它们运行得不好。

最好的产品评论通过模拟市场对您的想法的反应，将数月的学习时间压缩为一个小时。 

只有当房间里的人深入了解这个空间、具有良好的产品意识、强烈的意见并且通常是正确的时，这才有效。

太多的产品评论已经转向状态更新、领导力可见性和跨职能协调。

当这种情况发生时，人们自然会怨恨他们，因为这感觉更像是开销，而不是学习。

amasad.en:
We’re entering a new era of exploration.

Our ancestors mapped the Earth. Then they explored space.

Our generation may explore the computational universe: the vast space of algorithms, programs, proofs, and designs that AI agents can search.
amasad.zh:
我们正在进入一个新的探索时代。

我们的祖先绘制了地球地图。然后他们探索了太空。

我们这一代人可能会探索计算宇宙：人工智能代理可以搜索的算法、程序、证明和设计的广阔空间。

rauchg.en:
In our latest  benchmarks, Grok 4.5 has emerged as the best cybersecurity AI model on price-performance.

It's 10x cheaper than Sol, 5.7x cheaper than Opus 5, and 2.2x cheaper than Kimi K3, yet at Kimi-like perf.

Sol remains the frontier, ahead of Opus 5.
rauchg.zh:
在我们最新的基准测试中，Grok 4.5 已成为性价比最佳的网络安全人工智能模型。

它比 Sol 便宜 10 倍，比 Opus 5 便宜 5.7 倍，比 Kimi K3 便宜 2.2 倍，但性能却与 Kimi 相当。

Sol 仍然处于领先地位，领先于 Opus 5。
